1933, October
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK. NO. 5.
Page 153 Cont.
Oct. 17 Carl Kmgery - 25 (?) - Methodist - never baptized - now deserted by wife - ought to be Catholic, whom he married 11 yrs. - back before Justice, threatened with insanity, directed hither by Jew- ish lady - Enrolled To-day .... x
Mrs. Nora Tenbush - 24 - milkleg - 3 children of her own & 3 of her sisters.
Edw'd Collins - 10 - once cancer - sore heel now. Parents Graff - anointed - in New Baltimore.
Page 154
Oct. 21 Irene Bruechert - 17 - T.B. of throat. Mother promises perpetual - enrol .... if Dr. be surprised.
Rose M. Danzer - 53 - "possessed" ?....
21 Eliz. Pollet - 37 - paralized Aug. 1932 - nervous anxious - enrol- led perpetually To-day.
Cath. Danders - 60 - stroke (2nd) - Ist 4 yrs.
22 Oct. 11 - enrolled - 50c - Mrs. Helen Meteyer - 42 - had breast re- moved a yr. ago. Some months ago she was operated again - was feel- ing fine for a few days after enrollment; since has become worse again.
Mrs. Mary Werd - 61 - of London, Ont. - losing sight .. . .. R.H. Marcotte - 45 - wayward not faithful to family .....
Helen DeBusscher - 27 - fears operation - has 3 small children .... Mary Stein - 28 non c. - T.B. 11 yrs ago ... never very well since. now heart ... Enrolled To-day.
Page 155 Oct. 22 Mary Michael - 28 - feared T.B. fears. Mary Louise McGraw - 12 - cross-eyed - threatened loss of one Eye. Mrs. Knapp - 1927 - 1933 improving. Mrs. Kauffman. . Daughter.
